draft.subject: your knowledge management hire
draft.body:
Hi Alan,

Saw Merritt Kaye is hiring a knowledge management attorney to maintain your forms and precedents. Keeping that know-how searchable without sending it to a public AI tool is the tricky part.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this on your radar? And would a 15-minute call next week make sense?

claims.text: Merritt Kaye is hiring a knowledge management attorney to maintain your forms and precedents
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Knowledge Management Attorney. Build and maintain our forms, precedents and research memos.
Merritt Kaye LLP opens an office in Tacoma.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

findings.span: And would a 15-minute call next week make sense?
